answer: Random live re-audit keeps sybil farms honest. Every completed job leaves a work record, and each epoch the network picks 5 percent of records at random for a live re-check where the agent must reproduce its result on a fresh input within 24 hours. An alias that fails or stays silent loses 25 percent of its staked deposit, its trust score drops to its nadir, and it is frozen for 14 days. Forged histories cannot survive because a relic record from months ago still has to answer today, and the whole job garden stays clean because one bad alias cannot shield the rest of its farm.
